title: NCFBot Source Sidecar Record
description: Provenance metadata sidecar for every factual resource Markdown file in the ncfbot corpus. Each resource file must have a neighboring <name>.source.json that conforms to this schema.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier unique across the entire corpus. Never reuse or rename after other sidecars reference it.

resource_file.description: Repo-relative path to the paired Markdown resource file, e.g. resources/students/academic-model.md

title.description: Human-readable resource title matching the Markdown file's top-level heading.

audiences.description: Which audiences this resource primarily serves. Use 'shared' for cross-role content.

topics.description: Short topic slugs used by the retrieval layer to filter resources, e.g. ['registration', 'add-drop'].

sources.description: Every public source consulted when authoring or updating this resource.

canonical_url.description: Canonical HTTPS URL of the public source page or document.

publisher.description: Office, catalog, or body responsible for this source, e.g. 'NCF Registrar' or 'Undergraduate Catalog 2024-2025'.

authority_type.description: Category of source authority. Determines default trust rank when sources conflict.

retrieved_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this URL was independently fetched and verified, e.g. 2026-08-31T14:00:00Z.

last_modified.description: HTTP Last-Modified value if returned by the server, else null.

effective_from.description: Date or term from which the source content is effective, e.g. '2024-08-26' or 'Fall 2024'. Null if unknown.

effective_through.description: Date or term through which the source content is effective. Null if ongoing or unknown.

academic_year.description: Applicable academic year in YYYY-YYYY format, e.g. '2024-2025', or null.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of the retrieved source body. Null only before first verified fetch; must be populated after fetch_sources.py runs.

public_access_verified.description: True only if a human confirmed the URL is reachable without authentication or credentials. Never set true based on assumption.

status.description: Lifecycle state of this resource. 'current' = actively maintained and applicable. 'historical' = describes a past period. 'superseded' = replaced by a newer resource. 'deferred' = not yet authored. 'rejected' = excluded; see notes.

volatility.description: How quickly the underlying facts are expected to change. Drives review_after scheduling and freshness warnings.

review_after.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) after which this resource should be re-verified. check_freshness.py flags overdue records.

notes.description: Known conflicts, coverage gaps, ambiguities, or empty string if none. Required field; do not omit even if empty.
